page_title: VER 0-3 TOR | Verona v Torino 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Amin Sarr (Verona) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar.

90+1' 0 - 3 Alieu Njie (Torino) controls the ball with a great first touch just outside the penalty area after receiving a pass and smashes the ball into the roof of the net to give the goalkeeper no chance!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

87' 0 - 2 Brilliant finish! Cesare Casadei (Torino) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Alieu Njie, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:2.
86' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

85' Adrien Tameze (Torino) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Adrien Tameze (Torino) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Torino.
83' A substitution has been made. Che Adams goes off and Alieu Njie (Torino) comes on.
83' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Zakaria Aboukhlal and he is replaced by Ali Dembele (Torino).
81' Gift Orban (Verona) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
76' It's time for a substitution. Amin Sarr (Verona) comes on in place of Daniel Mosquera.
75' The substitution has been made. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) has replaced Antoine Bernede.
75' Here is a change. Gvidas Gineitis is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Cesare Casadei (Torino).
75' Substitution. Duvan Zapata (Torino) in, Giovanni Simeone out.
74' Gift Orban (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alberto Paleari intercepts the ball.
72' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
72' Abdou Harroui (Verona) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' The opposition give Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
69' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.

68' Martin Frese (Verona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
67' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Suat Serdar will be replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
67' Substitution. Adrien Tameze (Torino) has come on for Emirhan Ilkhan.
66' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' A cross from Giovane (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
65' Antoine Bernede (Verona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
64' Suat Serdar (Verona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
63' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
61' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle as Suat Serdar (Verona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
60' Unai Nunez (Verona) jumps highest to win the header from the corner, but his close-range attempt is well blocked by a defender.
60' Giovane (Verona) prepares to take a corner kick.
60' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Verona win a corner.
58' A dangerous looking corner kick from Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) is cleared to safety by the defence.
58' Che Adams (Torino) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
56' A yellow-coloured card is received by Alberto Paleari (Torino).
55' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
53' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
53' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
50' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
48' The resulting corner, taken by Suat Serdar (Verona), comes to nothing.
46' The game is over for Al Musrati. Gift Orban (Verona) comes on for the second half.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a switch. Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) is coming on in place of Daniel Oyegoke at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Antonio Rapuano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The ball rebounds out to Nikola Vlasic (Torino) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
45+3' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+2' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

45+1' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' Giovane (Verona) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
43' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Suat Serdar (Verona) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Alberto Paleari.
39' Giovane (Verona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
36' Shots on target – 1:2.
33' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
30' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
30' Torino are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
29' Giovane (Verona) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
25' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
21' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

20' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Lorenzo Montipo sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.

20' Che Adams (Torino) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
19' Giovane (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
15' The ball is cleared after Giovane (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' Martin Frese (Verona) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alberto Paleari has no trouble gathering it.
14' Giovane (Verona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
13' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

10' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Giovanni Simeone (Torino) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 0:1.

8' The cross into the penalty area from Giovane (Verona) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
6' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
4' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
4' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' The ball spins out to Che Adams (Torino) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just past the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano will officiate today.
